findings.evidence: | Preserve existing formatting conventions (heading levels, list style, code fences) of the document. | The author chose them. |
findings.fix: Delete this row and the duplicate 'Editing the review report' Common Mistakes row (line 111); line 46 and line 47 already cover them, and the model follows these conventions by default.

findings.evidence: Build an internal checklist: every CRITICAL and every HIGH finding becomes a task. MEDIUM findings are tasks if trivial; otherwise they are escalation candidates.
findings.fix: Finish the triage order: say how LOW findings are handled (default: defer to 'Findings not yet addressed'), and add a final step that Reads the edited document back and checks each addressed finding's Required: text before writing the summary.

findings.evidence: ## Common Mistakes table mostly restates the Editing rules (rewriting unflagged sections, adding features, editing the report)
findings.fix: Replace the repeated rows with a Gotchas list of environment facts the model would miss: the worktree codebase root versus the CWD (line 35), inline content that disappears when the subagent ends (line 20), and the orchestrator parsing the exact Status line. Give each one its non-obvious reason.

findings.evidence: description: Use when a review report from `ai-kit-spec-review-checklist` ... has been produced ... (no 'not for' boundary against the reviewer skill or general code-review feedback)
findings.fix: Apply a structured spec review report to a design or plan document: edit the document in place so every CRITICAL and HIGH finding meets its Required: outcome, escalate strategy-level findings without editing, keep framework conventions (EARS, Given/When/Then, task checkboxes, ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED deltas) and return a per-finding Fix Summary. Use when an orchestrator such as /ai-kit-spec-review sends a fixer subagent, or when asked to fix, address or resolve review findings on a spec, PRD, design doc or plan, even without the word 'fixer'. Not for producing the review itself (ai-kit-spec-review-checklist) or for code review feedback on source code.

findings.evidence: If a path, `Read` it before editing and respect its conventions (see Editing rules).
findings.fix: Name the profile fields the fixer must check (requirement syntax, task format, delta headers), so the agent loads only the relevant part of a large profile.

findings.evidence: write it verbatim to a temp file and `Read` that file back
findings.fix: Give the exact temp location the orchestrator expects (for example a path under the repo's tmp/), so later iterations can find the persisted report.

findings.evidence: Only a narrative TDD record (test-scenarios.md); there is no evals/evals.json and no evals/trigger-queries.json
findings.fix: Add evals/evals.json with the three recorded scenarios turned into prompts, input files from the checklist fixtures and verifiable assertions (for example 'Status line is Escalation Required', 'design-to-fix-skill.md is byte-identical after the run'). Add evals/trigger-queries.json with about 20 queries, including near-misses such as 'review this design doc' and 'address these PR review comments on my code'.

findings.evidence: Line 48: 'Address it AND note your disagreement'; line 82: 'Findings skipped (with disagreement noted) ... NOT addressed in this pass'; line 110: 'Address it OR document disagreement'
findings.fix: Settle on one rule. For CRITICAL and HIGH, always address the finding and list the disagreement under 'Findings addressed'. Allow skipping with disagreement only for MEDIUM and LOW. Update line 48, the skipped section and the Common Mistakes row to match.

findings.evidence: ### Status: Edits Applied | Escalation Required | No Edits (all skipped/escalated) — but line 20 emits 'Status: Failure — document not on disk', and line 63 says escalation output is 'a short message'
findings.fix: Add 'Failure' to the Status enum. State that an escalation is still reported inside the Fix Summary (Findings escalated plus Status: Escalation Required), and give the Status to use when some findings were edited and others escalated.
